description: This is a Swift source file that implements a simple build-time static site generator for the 'Swift Recipe Explorer' frontend. It creates static HTML, CSS, and JS files into a 'public' directory and includes code to run the generator and handle errors.

classes.name: StaticSiteGenerator
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates the logic for generating static site files, including creating directories and writing file contents.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that executes the site generation: ensures the output directory exists and writes index.html, styles.css, app.js, and health.txt files.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the given URL and creates it if it does not.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes the given string contents to a specified URL, using atomic write options.
